text:
cassie: OrbitTel POC ask: must keep all payloads and control-plane telemetry inside EU, BYOK using customer HSM, and a notarized snapshot of sub-processors. AE needs a short options brief for presales + timeline. Who can help?

mike-ops: I can scope ops. Two quick clarifiers: 1) tenant sticky routing (pin to eu-west) acceptable for the POC? 2) do they require vendor-hosted EU control plane or customer-managed VPC control plane?

cassie: Tenant-sticky is fine. They prefer vendor-hosted EU control-plane so long as no telemetry leaves EU.

tony-legal: If vendor control-plane must be EU-only, standard hosted offering won't comply unless we provision a Private control plane in EU or an EU-only control-plane deployment. I will pull subproc export + SOC2 dates and prepare a notarized bundle. Also need to confirm scope of "control-plane telemetry" (list of fields).

emma-pricing: I can draft cost deltas. Need POC load: baseline qps, peak bursts, tokens/request, model choice, POC duration.

cassie: POC inputs: baseline 7 qps, peaks 45 qps (short bursts), avg 140 tokens/req, model: 13B quant preferred but open to 7B, duration: 30 days.

li-ml: Model note: 13B quant will increase infra footprint; 7B quant recommended if cost-sensitive. I can include latency estimates for both.

infra-bot: presales-snippet:
```
route_policy: "tenant_pin: eu-west-1"
control_plane_residency: "eu_only: true"
kms: "BYOK-HSM: external endpoints, mTLS, cert_exchange"
fallback: "fallback_model: 7B-quant"
network_requirements: "ip_allowlist, peering, NAT, egress_rules"
```
Note: hosted+BYOK requires outbound mTLS to customer HSM endpoints; if customer firewall blocks outbound TLS, a VPC connector or Private deployment is required.

sara-se: Security ask: we need a customer contact for cert exchange and the HSM vendor details. Also request their acceptance criteria if failover to non-BYOK is allowed during maintenance.

tony-legal: I'll prepare the DPA addendum template and the notarized subproc pack once legal contact provided. If they refuse any control-plane telemetry leaving EU -> Private required and lead-time increases.

emma-pricing: Initial ballpark (EUR/month) for 30-day POC: HOSTED+GEO_PIN: ~2.6k + one-time networking ~3.0k; DEDICATED EU RESERVED: ~8.7k + onboarding ~2.0k; PRIVATE EU CONTROL-PLANE: ~17.5k + integration SOW ~6-8k, lead time 3-6 weeks. BYOK-HSM integration SOW: ~4k-7k.

mike-ops: Ops caveat: hosted+BYOK is fastest (~2-3 business days) but control-plane EU-only restriction likely forces PRIVATE or custom EU-only control-plane (adds ~3-6 weeks). Also need to plan cert stamping, mutual TLS tests, and a documented fail-closed/maintenance window policy.

cassie: Can someone produce a single-page decision table (Security/compliance, Cost estimate, Lead time, Ops complexity, Recommended for POC)? Need by EOD so AE can share with customer. Also schedule a 20m handoff tomorrow.

li-ml: I'll add a short appendix with latency and quant recommendations for 7B vs 13B.

tony-legal: I'll deliver notarized subproc snapshot + DPA draft by EOD if customer legal contact provided.

emma-pricing: I'll assemble the one-pager with the numbers and footnote BYOK SOW.

mike-ops: I'll draft the ops checklist: network flows, cert exchange steps, acceptance tests, and estimated setup time per option. Post it here when ready.

cassie: Thanks team :thumbsup: I'll confirm customer legal contact and schedule the handoff for 10:00 CET tomorrow.
